correctness.rationale: PASS: Direct multiplication confirms B=Q^4-I=[[1,3],[3,4]], B²=5(B+I), det B=-5, and C1=(Q^20-I)/5=[[836,1353],[1353,2189]], det C1=-605. The fifth-power lifting recurrence preserves C_j mod25 for j>=1, hence C_j has a 5-adic unit entry and determinant valuation exactly one. Smith valuations of Q^(4*5^j)-I are (j,j+1), yielding fixed-point kernel 5^(min(j,k)+min(j+1,k)). Mod5 the sole eigenvalue 3 has multiplicative order 4, so positive periods of nonzero vectors are divisible by 4; every period divides 4*5^k. Differencing nested fixed sets gives exact disjoint lengths and multiplicities. Independently reconstructed and exhaustively enumerated all 5^(2k) states for k=1,2,3 and confirmed predicted orbit histograms; source verifier covers through k=4. Computations corroborate rather than establish the infinite lifting.
